description:
Download videos from YouTube

There are so many interesting things to be found on YouTube, but you can't download the videos or save them as audio files by default. That's why we developed YouTube Video Downloader. This app will help you to accomplish video downloads quickly and without hangups. With our program you can simply download the whole playlist or YouTube channel at once and watch it whenever and wherever you want.
- added support for W.tv
- added support for Jamendo
- added support for Zoom clips
- fixed download from Audiomack
- fixed download from TikTok, Instagram, Reddit and Bandcamp
- fixed download from Apple Podcasts
- fixed download of Twitch clips
- fixed 2K and 4K quality for Vimeo
- fixed a bug when only 480p was available for Bilibili videos
- fixed download of large SoundCloud playlists
- fixed YouTube playlists disappearing from the list without a message
- fixed download of YouTube live streams that have just ended
- fixed audio description being chosen instead of the original audio track
- fixed 'Remove completed' removing videos that were not downloaded
- fixed the sample rate setting not being saved
- fixed downloads that slowed down and never recovered
- fixed high memory usage and freezing with many parallel downloads
- [win] fixed settings not being saved for users with a long download history
- lots of improvements for YouTube
- minor improvements for stability
